newsitem.title: USA: Dow rises 50, NYSE sets trading curbs.
newsitem.headline: Dow rises 50, NYSE sets trading curbs.

text.p: The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 50 points at Monday's opening to 7219 and the New York Stock Exchange set trading curbs at 1012 EDT/1412 GMT.

Analysts said the market was showing strength ahead of the rate-setting Federal Open Market Committee meeting May 20. Investors also were keeping an eye on retail sales data out Tuesday, the first of a weeklong raft of economic figures.
The Dow industrials were up 50 at 7219 and the Nasdaq composite was up 6.22 at 1341.27.
